description: This file is the entry point for a React frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React DOM root and renders the App component within React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components in a specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the created root, starting with React.StrictMode and the App component.
